d: In this premiere episode of Great Migrations from Nat Geo Animals and narrated by Alec Baldwin, discover remarkable animal journeys across the globe. Witness the dramatic migration of Christmas Island's red crabs as they travel from interior forests to mate on the beaches, braving battles with ferocious yellow ants. Watch the heartbreaking moment a wildebeest calf falls prey to crocodiles, as part of the 300-mile journey the wildebeest make each year.
